description: France insolvency claim deadlines. For 1 to 50 French companies (SIREN): insolvency proceedings published in the BODACC (safeguard, receivership, liquidation), and for each opening judgment the exact last day for a creditor to file a claim (2 months after publication, 4 if abroad; art. R622-24 Code de commerce), days left, appointed liquidator and the notice link. For credit managers, accountants, debt collectors. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402).
